All done. Summary:

**Rollback completed:** checkout-api was failing health checks on **v2.3.1** (18% error rate) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. I rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was previously healthy in production (no change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 had a healthy production track record). The first rollback attempt only completed in us-east due to an orchestrator error; I verified state and retried, completing us-west and eu-west. The service is now fully on v2.3.0 and **healthy** with error rate back to ~0.2%.

**Incident opened:** Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** — "checkout-api health check failures after latest deploy" — documenting the v2.3.1 health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the orchestrator error encountered during rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
